About

Not a clinic

Severe eczema or an existing egg allergy needs a clinician before peanut. Breathing trouble after a food is an emergency.

Start here

What the first foods are actually for

The job of food in the second half of the first year is iron, energy, and learning to eat. It is not a target for protein percentages.

When to start

The useful window is after four months and by about six. Readiness is a set of skills, and age still has a floor.

What to introduce, and when

There is no mandatory calendar of single vegetables. There is a reason to bring allergens in early and to keep them in the diet.

Introducing allergens

Delaying peanut, egg, and milk does not prevent allergy. For most babies the safer plan is to start them, in a safe texture, and keep them coming.

Picky eating

Suspicion of new food is a normal toddler stage. Growth, not the day’s plate, tells you when to ask for help.

When a child is ill

Familiar food, enough fluid, and the usual milk. A sick day is a bad day to diagnose an allergy or to start a new one.
